clauses.reason: Terminated by express supersession. EO 9733, signed June 4, 1946, states "This order supersedes Executive Order No. 9538 of April 13, 1945" and re-enacts the authorization. The wording has no effective-date clause, so the recorded date is the signing date 1946-06-04 (filed June 4, printed June 6, 1946, the alternative reading). Later event: EO 9830 Part III lists No. 9538 of April 13, 1945 for revocation effective 1947-05-01 (enacting clause); that revocation fell on an order already superseded and is not the first end.

research_rationale:
Identity and text: read in full in the registered Federal Register original (10 FR, issue of 1945-04-27; grade original_representation_unverified, acceptable_as_original true). Order 9538 of April 13, 1945 authorizes the Civil Service Commission to certify for probational appointment persons who lost an appointment opportunity because of armed-forces service, on request within ninety days after the end of service or hospitalization or after the date of the order, whichever is later. Inventory: one sole paragraph. End: EO 9733, signed June 4, 1946 (11 FR 6127, held), ordered in paragraph 3 "This order supersedes Executive Order No. 9538 of April 13, 1945" and re-enacted the same authorization in its paragraph 1 (now 'authorized and directed'). EO 9830 later lists 'No. 9538 of April 13, 1945' for revocation effective 1947-05-01; that is a later formal revocation of an order already superseded, recorded as a later event, not the first end. EO 9598 (1945-08-17) states that it 'does not supersede or modify' EO 9538, so it is a recital and not an end.
Member checks: {"earlier_end_check":"Own terms: the ninety-day wording is an applicant's request period that runs from the later of two dates, including the end of each person's service or hospitalization, so it supplies no fixed end of the authorization and is a deadline, not an end. EO 9598 expressly does not supersede it. No instrument before EO 9733 revokes, supersedes or exhausts it on held evidence. Search coverage: the later-events catalogue (OFR disposition notes from 1937) and the held order texts; Public Land Orders and Civil Service Commission notices printed in issues without an executive order are not searched.","independent_command_check":"No separate command in the order. The authority continues independently in EO 9733 paragraph 1.","savings_check":"See savings reason; no savings wording preserving EO 9538 beyond EO 9733's own re-enactment.","scope_check":"One clause. savings.reason: EO 9733 paragraph 1 re-enacts the same certification authority with the same eligibility conditions, so the function continued under a separate command; paragraph 2 adds further classes. EO 9733 has no wording preserving EO 9538 itself.
